==Notes==
*The damage to adjacent foes is [[Armor-ignoring damage|armor-ignoring]].
*Can be rotated with [[Moebius Strike]] for constant [[area of effect]] damage.
*This [[skill]] is one of the three skills that form the basis of [[dagger spammer]] [[build]]s.

==Trivia==
*The name of this skill may be a reference to an attack pattern used in the film [[w:The_Last_Starfighter|"The Last Starfighter"]].
